What is MTR and Why is it Useful?
什么是MTR，为什么有用？

Writer: Tim Keary
编剧：蒂姆·基里
Network Security and Administration Expert 网络安全与管理专家
Updated: November 29, 2024 更新日期：2024年11月29日
We discuss MTR, known as Matt's Traceroute, and how to utilize this tool for network monitoring. Includes examples and alternative tools you can consider 我们讨论了MTR，即Matt的Traceroute，以及如何利用该工具进行网络监控。包含示例和你可以考虑的替代工具

In the world of networking, diagnosing connectivity issues can be a challenging task. One of the most commonly used tools for understanding the path that data takes across networks is the TraceRoute command. However, while TraceRoute is effective, it has its limitations, such as providing one-time snapshots without any ongoing monitoring. Enter Matt’s TraceRoute (MTR) – a more dynamic and informative tool that combines the functionality of TraceRoute with advanced real-time analysis.
在网络领域，诊断连接问题可能是一项具有挑战性的任务。理解数据在网络中路径的最常用工具之一是TraceRoute命令。然而，尽管TraceRoute有效，但也存在局限性，例如提供一次性快照且没有持续监控。这时，Matt的TraceRoute（MTR）——一款更具动态和信息量的工具，结合了TraceRoute的功能与先进的实时分析。

MTR provides network administrators, engineers, and IT professionals with a continuous, real-time view of the network route and its performance, making it an invaluable resource for diagnosing routing problems, latency, and packet loss.
MTR为网络管理员、工程师和IT专业人员提供连续、实时的网络路由及其性能视图，是诊断路由问题、延迟和丢包的宝贵资源。

The service works continuously, combining Ping and TraceRoute functionality but providing a much better display than those original command line tools. Most network administrators are very familiar with both Ping and TraceRoute and probably use these two utilities regularly for a quick investigation of what is going on with connectivity or device availability.
该服务持续运行，结合了 Ping 和 TraceRoute 功能，但显示效果远优于原始命令行工具。大多数网络管理员对Ping和TraceRoute都非常熟悉，可能经常使用这两个工具快速检查连接情况或设备可用性。

Whether you’re troubleshooting issues on a local network or diagnosing problems with your Internet service provider, MTR offers a more comprehensive and user-friendly approach than traditional TraceRoute. This article will delve into how MTR works, its advantages over conventional tools, and how to use it effectively to optimize network performance and resolve connectivity issues.
无论您是在本地网络排查问题，还是与互联网服务提供商进行诊断，MTR都比传统TraceRoute提供更全面且用户友好的方法。本文将深入探讨MTR的工作原理、其相较于传统工具的优势，以及如何有效利用它来优化网络性能和解决连接问题。

What is Ping? 什么是Ping？

Ping is one of the most commonly-used network diagnostic tools in the world. With Ping, the user can send ICMP packets from one computer to another. The receiving computer then replies with ICMP echo reply packets once the packets have arrived. This ICMP echo reply packet tells you if a device is available or not. If a computer doesn’t send a reply back then you know that it isn’t available.
Ping是全球最常用的网络诊断工具之一。通过Ping，用户可以将ICMP数据包从一台计算机发送到另一台计算机。接收计算机在数据包到达后，会用 ICMP 回声回复包进行回复。这个ICMP回声回复包会告诉你设备是否可用。如果电脑没有回复，那你就知道它不可用了。

You can also ping hostnames to monitor DNS connectivity. Generally, network administrators use the Ping tool to measure the availability of hosts across a network. While this sounds good in theory, it is important to note that Ping isn’t always accurate. ICMP packets are often filtered by firewalls meaning that sometimes devices that are up and running don’t respond with ICMP packets.
你也可以ping主机名来监控DNS连接。通常，网络管理员使用 Ping 工具来衡量网络中主机的可用性。虽然理论上听起来不错，但需要注意的是，Ping并不总是准确的。ICMP数据包通常被防火墙过滤，这意味着有时运行中的设备无法响应ICMP数据包。

See also: The Best Ping Monitoring Tools
另见：最佳Ping监控工具

What is Traceroute? 什么是Traceroute？

Traceroute is another widely-used networking tool that records the route between the sender and the receiver. It is different from Ping because it calculates the route and shows the user the amount of time taken for a packet to traverse each hop.
Traceroute 是另一种广泛使用的网络工具，用于记录发送方与接收方之间的路由。它与 Ping 不同，因为它计算路由并向用户展示数据包每次跳跃所需的时间。

Traceroute is primarily used to pinpoint problem areas within a network. If one hop takes particularly long to travel through then that is a good indication that there is a problem somewhere in the network. To use Traceroute all the user needs to do is enter the traceroute command.
Traceroute 主要用于定位网络中的问题区域。如果某一跳传输特别长，那就是网络中存在问题的好迹象。使用Traceroute只需输入traceroute命令即可。

The command sends off an ICMP packet with a time to live value. Every packet that you send has a TTL field. The TTL is the maximum number of hops that a packet can travel before it is discarded. The sender sets the TTL value so that once it is exceeded, the router will drop the packet and notify the original sender with a time-exceeded message.
该命令发送一个带有存活时间值的ICMP数据包。你发送的每个数据包都有一个TTL字段。TTL是数据包在丢弃前能传输的最大跳数。发送方设置TTL值，一旦超过TTL，路由器会丢弃数据包，并用超时消息通知原始发送方。

The TTL and the time exceeded together can be used to determine how long it takes for a packet to travel from one hop to another. Once the Traceroute is complete you can then see the number of milliseconds (ms) that the packet took to reach a router. As a result, Traceroute is a good tool for measuring the latency within a network.
TTL和超过的时间可以一起计算数据包从一跳到下一跳所需的时间。Traceroute完成后，你可以看到数据包到达路由器所需的毫秒（毫秒）。因此，Traceroute 是衡量网络内延迟的良好工具。

The longer it takes for a packet to travel through a hop, the more latency there is. The presence of a high amount of latency tells a network administrator that the network isn’t performing as it should be. Traceroute is included by default on Windows and Unix operating systems. However, it can also be installed via an online download.
数据包通过跳跃的时间越长，延迟越大。高延迟的存在告诉网络管理员网络表现不佳。Traceroute 默认包含在 Windows 和 Unix作系统上。不过，也可以通过在线下载安装。

See also: Traceroute Tools Review
另见：Traceroute工具评测

What is MTR? 什么是MTR？

The MTR network monitor combines Ping and Traceroute and combines the availability measuring capabilities of Ping with the hop-to-hop analysis of Traceroute. MTR uses ICMP packets to measure the availability of devices and the length of time taken to travel from hop to hop.
MTR网络监控器结合了Ping和Traceroute，并结合了Ping的可用性测量功能与Traceroute的跳对跳分析。MTR使用ICMP数据包来衡量设备的可用性以及从一跳到另一跳传输所需的时间。

However, what really sets MTR apart from other limited tools is that it records packet loss and jitter as well. MTR thus measures the quality of a connection time it takes to complete a transfer and the percentage of packets lost in transit.
然而，MTR与其他有限工具的最大区别在于它还能记录丢包和抖动。因此，MTR衡量的是完成传输所需的连接时间质量以及传输过程中丢包的百分比。

When using MTR you run reports to view performance data. Reports gather data from your network and then feed it back to you in the form of an onscreen table. The table shows you information on packet loss and latency.
使用MTR时，你会运行报表来查看性能数据。报告从你的网络收集数据，然后以屏幕上的表格形式反馈给你。表格显示了丢包和延迟的信息。

See Also: Fix Packet Loss
另见：修复丢包

Why is MTR Useful? 为什么MTR有用？

MTR is a useful tool for a number of reasons. First, it combines Ping and Traceroute together to be able to measure the availability of devices in the network as well as monitoring the route. However, it also has a significant advantage over Traceroute because the output is updated continuously. With Traceroute, you have to update scans manually to measure how a network’s performance changes over time.
MTR是一个有用的工具，有很多原因。首先，它结合了Ping和Traceroute，能够测量网络中设备的可用性并监控路由。然而，它相较于 Traceroute 也有显著优势，因为输出是持续更新的。使用Traceroute时，你需要手动更新扫描数据，以衡量网络性能随时间的变化。

In contrast, you can run MTR and your information will be connected until you say stop. Being able to monitor the change in network performance over time helps when it comes to troubleshooting.
相比之下，你可以运行MTR，直到你说停，你的信息都会一直连接在一起。能够监控网络性能随时间的变化，有助于排查问题。

MTR is available for users with Windows, Mac OS, and Linux. The installation process differs according to which platform you’re working on.
MTR面向Windows、Mac OS和Linux用户开放。安装过程会根据你使用的平台而异。

要在Windows上下载MTR，可以通过此链接下载Windows版本WINMTR。

To install MTR on Mac OS you can use Homebrew or Macports. On Home-brew you need to enter the following command:
要在Mac OS上安装MTR，可以使用Homebrew或Macports。在自制软件中，你需要输入以下命令：

Alternatively, to run MTR with MacPorts you need to enter:
另外，要用MacPort运行MTR，你需要输入：

To install MTR on Linux you need Debian, Ubuntu, CentOS, RHEL, or Fedora. For Debian and Ubuntu you can enter the following command:
要在Linux上安装MTR，你需要Debian、Ubuntu、CentOS、RHEL或Fedora。对于Debian和Ubuntu，你可以输入以下命令：

apt update && apt upgrade

apt install mtr-tiny

On CentOS, RHEL and Fedora you can enter the following command:
在 CentOS、RHEL 和 Fedora 上，你可以输入以下命令：

yum update

yum install mtr

How to Use MTR 如何使用MTR

When using the MTR network scanner, you need to generate an MTR report in order to view your traffic data. MTR reports are directional so it is necessary to generate reports in both directions to get a complete picture of your network’s performance. In this section, we’re going to look at how you can do this. The process is different depending on what platform you’re working on.
使用MTR网络扫描器时，您需要生成MTR报告以查看您的交通数据。MTR报告具有方向性，因此需要双向生成报告，才能全面了解网络性能。在本节中，我们将探讨如何实现这一点。具体流程会因你使用的平台而异。

In this section we’re going to look at:
在本节中我们将探讨：

  • How to generate and read MTR reports
    如何生成和阅读MTR报告
  • How to measure packet loss
    如何测量丢包
  • How to measure latency
    如何测量延迟
  • How to measure jitter
    如何测量抖动

Windows (with WinMTR) Windows（搭配 WinMTR）

To begin, go to the host field and enter your domain name. Now click Start. Once this is done packets will start to be transmitted. Packet transmission won’t stop until you press the Stop button. Packet data will be shown in the main canvas view which details the number of packets sent and received as well as the packet loss percentage.
首先，进入主机字段并输入你的域名。现在点击开始。完成后，数据包将开始传输。数据包传输不会停止，除非你按下停止按钮。数据包数据会显示在主画布视图中，该视图详细说明了发送和接收的数据包数量以及丢包百分比。

Linux

If you’re using the command line interface version of MTR on Linux, then you can generate a report by typing mtr followed by the URL that you want to analyze. For example:
如果你在Linux上使用MTR的命令行界面版本，那么你可以通过输入mtr和你想分析的URL来生成报告。例如：

mtr google.com

How to Read MTR Reports 如何阅读MTR报告

A key part of using the MTR network scanner is being able to read the results of a report. As you can see in the image above, the report command specifies where the packets are to be sent (in this instance google.com). The information shown on the report is as follows:
使用MTR网络扫描仪的一个关键部分是能够读取报告结果。如上图所示，report命令指定数据包的发送地点（此处为 google.com）。报告中显示的信息如下：

  • The numbered lines on the left-hand side of the screen refer to hops.
    屏幕左侧的编号线代表跳跃。
  • The names to the right of the numbers are the names of the hosts being contacted.
    数字右侧的名字是被联系的主持人姓名。
  • The Loss % column shows you packet loss.
    丢包百分比栏显示的是丢包。
  • The Snt column shows you the number of packets sent.
    Snt 栏显示发送了多少包。
  • The Last, Avg, Best and Worst all measure latency in ms. The Last is the latency of the last packet sent, Avg is the average latency and best and worst indicate the lowest and highest round-trip time for transmitted packets.
    最后、平均、最佳和最差的延迟都以毫秒为单位。最后一个延迟是最后一次发送的数据包的延迟，平均延迟为平均，最佳和最差则表示传输数据包的最低和最高往返时间。

How to Measure Packet loss with MTR 如何用MTR测量数据包丢失

To measure packet loss on the MTR network monitor, you can look at the numerical values under the Loss % column. However, when measuring packet loss with MTR there is one thing to remember: watch out for limiting. Limiting is when service providers place a cap on the amount of ICMP traffic sent by MTR.
要在MTR网络监控器上测量丢包，可以在丢包百分比栏下查看数值。然而，在用MTR测量丢包时，有一点需要记住：注意限制。限制是指服务提供商对MTR发送的ICMP流量设定上限。

ICMP rate limiting is used by service providers to prioritize other network traffic. As a consequence, reports can show packet loss that isn’t due to a configuration issue or fault but because a service provider is imposing a limit on ICMP traffic.
ICMP速率限制被服务提供商用来优先处理其他网络流量。因此，报告中可能显示的数据包丢失并非由配置问题或故障引起，而是因为服务提供商对ICMP流量施加了限制。

The biggest clue that traffic is being limited is to compare the packet loss between hops. If one hop has a high packet loss but the other surrounding hops are at 0% then it is almost certain that MTR is being limited. As a general rule, if you see lots of different rates of packet loss being reported it is advisable to trust the later hops.
流量被限制的最大线索是比较跳点之间的丢包情况。如果一个跳点丢包率很高，而周围其他跳点的丢包率为0%，那么几乎可以确定MTR被限制了。一般来说，如果你看到很多不同的丢包率报告，建议相信后面的跳数。

If you are troubleshooting for a particular issue in your network you want to make sure that you measure packet loss both ways. In doing so you will be able to see if there is a problem with the outward route or the return route.
如果你在排查网络中的某个特定问题，你需要确保双向测量丢包。这样你就能判断出出去路线或返程路线是否有问题。

How to Measure Latency with MTR
如何用MTR测量延迟

One of the key pieces of information that you can get from MTR reports is that of latency. Now viewing the latency relies on manually measuring a number of factors. 从MTR报告中可以获得的一个关键信息是延迟。现在查看延迟需要手动测量多个因素。

The first thing you want to do when reading a report is to pay attention to the hop numbers, and the last, average, best, and worst latency at each stage (as shown in the report example above). For example, if the latency jumps up dramatically between one hop to another then this can indicate that there is a problem in that part of the network. However, the latency can be caused by the outward route or the return route.
阅读报告时，首先要关注跳数，以及每个阶段的最后、平均、最佳和最差延迟（如上文报告示例所示）。例如，如果延迟在一跳之间急剧上升，这可能表明该网络部分存在问题。然而，延迟可能由外向路径或返回路径引起。

You won’t be able to see the return route in your report. Instead, you will have to look at the difference between the final hop and the one before it to see if there is a problem there as well. As a result, you will have to run further network troubleshooting to diagnose the source of the problem.
你在报告中看不到返回路线。相反，你需要观察最后一跳和前一跳的区别，看看那里是否也存在问题。因此，你需要进行进一步的网络排查，以诊断问题根源。

How to Measure Jitter on MTR 如何测量地铁上的抖动

You can also use MTR to measure jitter. However, you can’t see jitter on the standard report page. To view jitter you need to enter the option command:
你也可以用MTR来测量抖动。不过，你在标准报告页面上看不到抖动。要查看抖动，你需要输入 option 命令：

or -order

With this command, you can determine what fields will be displayed and In which order. The list of fields available is as follows:
通过这个命令，你可以决定将显示哪些字段以及按何种顺序显示。可用字段列表如下：

  • L – Loss ratio
    L – 损失比
  • D – Dropped packets
    D – 丢弃数据包
  • R – Received packets
    R – 接收包
  • S – Sent packets
    S – 发送数据包
  • N – Newest RTT (ms)
    N – 最新的RTT （ms）
  • B – Min/Best RTT (ms)
    B – 最小/最佳RTT（ms）
  • A – Average RTT (ms)
    A – 平均RTT（毫秒）
  • W – Max/Worst RTT (ms)
    W – 最大/最差RTT（毫秒）
  • V – Standard Deviation
    V – 标准差
  • G – Geometric Mean
    G – 几何平均
  • J – Current Jitter
    J – 当前抖动
  • M – Jitter Mean/Avg.
    M – 抖动平均/平均。
  • X – Worst Jitter
    X – 最严重抖动
  • I -Interarrival Jitter
    I -到达间抖动

Alternative Tools to MTR MTR的替代工具

Although MTR is a very reliable tool, there are a number of other alternative products that have emerged building off of the original Traceroute program. In this section, we’re going to look at some of the alternatives to MTR that you can use to monitor your network.
虽然MTR是一个非常可靠的工具，但基于原始Traceroute程序，也出现了许多其他替代产品。在本节中，我们将介绍一些MTR的替代方案，用于监控你的网络。

SolarWinds Traceroute NG (FREE TOOL) SolarWinds Traceroute NG（免费工具）

SolarWinds Traceroute NG is SolarWind’s alternative to the MTR network scanner and Traceroute. Traceroute NG can not only detect network path changes, but also offers continuous monitoring. With this program, network path analysis is offered for both TCP and ICMP to give the user-enhanced visibility.
SolarWinds Traceroute NG 是 SolarWind 对 MTR 网络扫描器和 Traceroute 的替代方案。Traceroute NG不仅能检测网络路径变化，还能提供持续监控。该程序为TCP和ICMP提供了网络路径分析，以增强用户的可视性。

Key Features: 主要特色：

  • Easy to install
    安装简便
  • Straightforward display
    直观的展示
  • Standard Traceroute function
    标准追踪路由函数
  • TCP and ICMP options
    TCP和ICMP选项
  • Completely free to use
    完全免费使用

Why do we recommend it? 我们为什么推荐它？

SolarWinds Traceroute NG is a free tool that provides a standard Traceroute function in a Windows interface, so you don’t need to go to the command line to run it. This small software package won’t tie up your computer’s processor. It can be used to see the path to an endpoint on your network or to a remote location.
SolarWinds Traceroute NG 是一个免费工具，在 Windows 界面中提供了标准的 Traceroute 功能，所以你无需进入命令行即可运行。这个小型软件包不会占用你电脑的处理器。它可以用于查看网络端点或远程地点的路径。

The program runs through a command line interface (CLI). You can view important details like IP addresses, hostnames, number of hops, packet loss, and latency. Being able to measure for performance concerns like packet loss tells you if there is a problem that needs to be dealt with.
该程序通过命令行接口（CLI）运行。你可以查看重要细节，如IP地址、主机名、跳数、丢包和延迟。能够测量数据包丢失等性能问题，可以告诉你是否存在需要处理的问题。

Who is it recommended for? 推荐给谁？

The Traceroute NG tool is permanently free, so you don’t need to be worried about it expiring or presenting you with a blocking message asking for money. It will run on Windows or Windows Server. It is worth installing this package just so you have an easy-to-use straightforward Windows Traceroute to hand.
Traceroute NG工具是永久免费的，所以你不用担心它过期或弹出要求付款的屏蔽信息。它可以运行在Windows或Windows Server上。安装这个软件包非常值得，这样你就有一个易于使用、直观的 Windows Traceroute 随手可得。

Pros:
优点：

  • Lightweight tool allows you to run it on virtually any network off of any machine
    轻量级工具允许你在任何机器上几乎在任何网络上运行它
  • Supports both IPv4 and IPv6, making it flexible or larger networks utilizing more modern protocols
    支持IPv4和IPv6，使其能够灵活或更大网络，采用更现代的协议
  • Acts as a troubleshooting tool to detect packet loss, jitter, and latency
    作为故障排除工具，用于检测丢包、抖动和延迟
  • Offers simple visual representations of network traffic
    提供网络流量的简单视觉表示
  • Is completely free
    完全免费

Cons:
缺点：

  • Advanced features such as enterprise reporting are supported but can be found in products like SolarWinds Network Performance Monitor
    支持企业报告等高级功能，但可在SolarWinds网络性能监控器等产品中找到

TraceRoute NG runs on Windows 8, 8.1, 10, Windows Server 2012 R2 and 2016. Even though Traceroute NG is a proprietary tool, it is available for free. If you’re not a fan of MTR, TraceRoute NG stands in as an excellent alternative.
TraceRoute NG 可在 Windows 8、8.1、10、Windows Server 2012 R2 和 2016 上运行。尽管 Traceroute NG 是一个专有工具，但它是免费可用的。如果你不喜欢MTR，TraceRoute NG是个很好的替代选择。

PRTG Network Monitor PRTG 网络监控器

PRTG Network Monitor is a network monitoring platform that offers a number of servers for Traceroute. PRTG Network Monitor is GUI-based so it is easy to use if you aren’t familiar with CLI’s. With the Traceroute Hop Count Sensor you can monitor your network and measure the execution time and number of hops of the transfer. The number of hops is shown as a green dial so that you can clearly see how far a packet has traveled.
PRTG Network Monitor 是一个网络监控平台，提供多台 Traceroute 服务器。PRTG Network Monitor 基于图形界面，如果你不熟悉 CLI，使用起来很简单。通过Traceroute跳数传感器，你可以监控网络，测量传输的执行时间和跳数。跳数以绿色旋钮显示，方便你清楚看到数据包的传输距离。

Key Features: 主要特色：

  • Network discovery
    网络发现
  • Network mapping
    网络映射
  • Traceroute and Ping
    追踪路由与 Ping
  • Live monitoring
    实时监控

Why do we recommend it? 我们为什么推荐它？

Paessler PRTG Network Monitor provides a device discovery routine that compiles a network inventory. This service repeats and so it notices when you add or remove equipment. The system draws up a network topology map based on the information in the inventory. There are a number of system testing tools in this package, including a Traceroute utility.
Paessler PRTG 网络监控器提供设备发现程序，用于编译网络清单。这项服务会重复，因此它会在你添加或移除设备时察觉到。系统根据库存信息绘制网络拓扑图。该软件包包含多种系统测试工具，包括 Traceroute 工具。

There is also a way to monitor jitter and packet loss on PRTG Network Monitor. There is a QOS Round Trip Sensor that shows you the jitter, latency, packet loss, and the mean opinion score of your network connection.
PRTG Network Monitor 上也有方法可以监控抖动和丢包。有一个QoS往返传感器，可以显示抖动、延迟、丢包以及网络连接的平均评价分数。

Who is it recommended for? 推荐给谁？

This system is very accessible for any size of business. You buy an allowance of sensors and then decide which of them you are going to turn on. The minimum quantity you can buy is 500 sensors, which is suitable for a small business. You don’t have to pay anything for the package if you only activate 100 sensors.
该系统对任何规模的企业都非常友好。你买了一套餐余额的传感器，然后决定要开启哪一个。你能购买的最低数量是500个传感器，这对小型企业来说是合适的。如果你只激活100个传感器，包裹费用就不高。

Pros:
优点：

  • Uses a combination of packet sniffing, WMI, and SNMP to report network performance as well as discover new devices
    结合数据包嗅探、WMI和SNMP来报告网络性能并发现新设备
  • Autodiscovery reflects the latest inventory changes almost instantaneously
    自动发现几乎能即时反映最新的库存变化
  • Drag and drop editor makes it easy to build custom views and reports
    拖放编辑器让创建自定义视图和报表变得简单
  • Supports a wide range of alert mediums such as SMS, email, and third-party integration
    支持多种警报媒介，如短信、电子邮件和第三方集成
  • Supports a freeware version
    支持免费版本

Cons:
缺点：

  • Is a very comprehensive platform with many features and moving parts that require time to learn
    这是一个非常全面的平台，拥有许多功能和动态部件，需要时间去学习

Like MTR, PRTG Network Monitor is available for free. If you want to expand your network monitoring then you can also incorporate other sensors for packet sniffing and NetFlow analysis.
与MTR一样，PRTG网络监控免费提供。如果你想扩展网络监控，还可以加入其他传感器进行数据包嗅探和NetFlow分析。

MTR Network Scanner: The Alternative to Ping and Traceroute MTR网络扫描器：Ping和追踪路由的替代方案

If you’re currently using Ping or Traceroute then making the change to MTR is well worth it. You’ll have the benefits of both tools in one platform. We’ve included a basic guide on how to use MTR here so that you can understand the basics of how to create and read reports. While the process is different depending on what platform you’re on, one thing all versions of MTR have in common is that they are easy to use.
如果你现在用的是Ping或Traceroute，那换成MTR非常值得。你将在同一平台上同时享受这两种工具的优势。我们这里提供了一份关于如何使用MTR的基础指南，帮助你了解如何创建和阅读报告的基础知识。虽然流程因平台不同而异，但所有版本的MTR都有一个共同点，就是它们都非常易用。

However, if you don’t like MTR then other competitors like TraceRoute NG or PRTG Network Monitor are also suitable alternatives. TraceRoute NG functions in much the same way with the ability to view ICMP and TCP data. PRTG Network Monitor is more of a complete network monitoring platform but it offers a Traceroute sensor that helps visualise the text-based Traceroute experience offered by MTR and Traceroute.
不过，如果你不喜欢MTR，其他竞争对手如TraceRoute NG或PRTG Network Monitor也是合适的替代品。TraceRoute NG 的功能与 TraceRoute 类似，能够查看 ICMP 和 TCP 数据。PRTG Network Monitor 更为完整，但它提供了一个 Traceroute 传感器，帮助可视化 MTR 和 Traceroute 提供的基于文本的 Traceroute 体验。

Matt’s Traceroute (MTR) FAQs Matt's Traceroute（地铁）常见问题解答

What is an MTR test?
什么是MTR测试？

An MTR test is the execution of the MTR program to look at the connection from the local computer through to a specific destination, which is given as either an IP address or a domain name. MTR combines Ping and TraceRoute and is short for Matt’s TraceRoute but some people say it stands for My TraceRoute. MTR测试是执行MTR程序，通过查看从本地计算机到特定目的地的连接，该目标以IP地址或域名的形式提供。MTR结合了Ping和TraceRoute，是Matt's TraceRoute的缩写，但有人说它是My TraceRoute的缩写。

What port does MTR use?
MTR使用哪个端口？

The base process of MTR uses the Internet Control Message Protocol (ICMP), which is a Network Layer protocol (Layer 3) and doesn’t include the concept of ports. However, it is possible to force MTR to use UDP with the command MTR -u. In this case, the tests start with a transmission to port 33000 and increase the port number with each successive test. It is also possible to force MTR to use TCP, in which case you specify the port number to use with MTR -P <PortNumber> -T.
MTR的基础过程使用互联网控制消息协议（ICMP），这是一种网络层协议（第3层），不包含端口的概念。不过，可以用命令 MTR -u 强制 MTR 使用 UDP。在这种情况下，测试从向端口33000发送传输开始，并随着每次测试端口号逐渐增加。也可以强制MTR使用TCP，此时你用MTR -P <PortNumber> -T</PortNumber>指定端口号。

Can MTR help with intermittent packet loss?
MTR能帮助解决间歇性丢包问题吗？

MTR can’t fix packet loss problems; it can only issue tests to report on the statuses of the likely route that connections will take to a given destination. Intermittent packet loss is a tricky situation to observe. You would need to run MTR several times in order to spot the problem occurring. Still, being able to see the packet loss problem won’t automatically fix it. MTR无法解决丢包问题;它只能发布测试，报告连接可能走的路线状态。间歇性丢包是一个难以观察的情况。你需要多次运行MTR才能发现问题。不过，能看到丢包问题并不会自动解决问题。
